note: All 5 products are built (team F1: the eval tracker; team D2: the other 4). Prices are inside what similar listings showed on 2026-11-14 (each product's shop/listing.md has the comparables, the reasoning and the fee table; docs/MONEY_MACHINES.md section 3). Sales estimates are guesses for a shop with no audience yet: most listings sell little until a social account or search traffic sends buyers.

products.name: Prop Eval Tracker (Excel + Google Sheets + offline web app)
products.comparables: Etsy prop-firm challenge tracker about $16.68 (sale from $22.24); trading journals $9.90-35; a journal + prop tracker bundle EUR 39
products.risk: Trading niche: no performance claims, no firm names; Gumroad reviews trading content more closely.

products.name: 5 one-page website templates for local businesses + an offline no-code Site Editor + a publish guide
products.source: the agency demo-site look (team B1's palettes, art and icons, CC0) rebuilt as a template pack with its own renderer and editor
products.comparables: single one-page HTML templates $1-20 (Gumroad $1/$12, Getly $19.99, Etsy about $5); Etsy trade website templates about $6-97
products.risk: Many buyers look for website-builder templates instead of HTML: the editor and the free-hosting guide answer that; no ranking promises.

products.name: 30-day social media kit for local businesses: offline Post Maker (30 editable designs, 3 sizes), 150 captions, the plan
products.source: upgraded from the planned '60 templates + 120 captions': a canvas Post Maker (no design-app account needed) + 150 hand-written captions
products.comparables: 30-day small-business kits $9 (Getly), $12-15 (Gumroad), $19.50 (Payhip); Etsy trade post packs about $5-15
products.risk: Crowded and many buyers expect a design-app version; we sell the no-account editor and the captions instead.

products.name: First clients agency starter kit: outreach scripts, discovery call, proposal, service agreement (not legal advice), onboarding, honest reviews, checklists, tracker, invoice
products.source: the agency kit's own know-how (pitch, billing, review booster, gig checklists) written as editable documents
products.comparables: Etsy developer and onboarding bundles $7.49-$16.73; Payhip kit $17; Gumroad up to $49; a pro contract pack $89
products.risk: Legal templates: marked NOT LEGAL ADVICE in the file, the licence and the listing; no client or income promises.

products.name: Trader's daily routine planner: 16 printable pages (Letter + A4) + a spreadsheet journal; process only, no signals
products.source: the Eval Journal account's routines (education only) as a planner; pairs with the eval tracker (a $25 bundle later)
products.comparables: printable trading journals $9.89 (Gumroad) to $29.99 (Payhip); a 1-page checklist CHF 7 (Whop); Etsy journal spreadsheets mostly $9-25
products.risk: Trading niche: no results, signals or firm names; the risk line on every listing.

folded.why: A $9 checklist is thin (Google's own help pages cover it) and the fixed fees eat ~10% of a $9 sale; as the 'local listing set-up' checklist in 07_Service_Checklists.docx it adds value to a $19 kit.
An $11 review kit carries the most misuse risk (incentives, gating) for little price; as 06_Reviews_and_Referrals.docx it ships with the FTC rules and honest scripts inside a bigger kit.
